title: Review goon.vc sign-ins
description: Approve or turn away people who signed in to goon.vc with Discord and are waiting for review. Only goon.vc's reviewers can run it.

approve.say:
Hi {{user.name|there}}! **{{context.waiting}}** waiting for review on goon.vc: they signed in with Discord and are in the waiting area ({{context.waitingUrl}}).
Pick everyone you approve, or Skip to approve nobody.

deny.say: Anyone to turn away? They'll see that on goon.vc. Skip to leave everyone else waiting.

cancelled.say: Nothing changed; everyone is still waiting. Run `/goon review` to pick it up again.
